_about: Hand tuning for tools/remix.py, applied after its rules: `budget` caps the swaps, `kinds` limits which tiles, `set` writes a tile at column,row (after mirroring, row 0 at top) last of all. From the level-analyst pass of 2026-10-06.

35.note: the original layout before Revision A eased it: four t tiles on the climb; the +5 s on the bottom row keeps it playable without the stub detour

43.note: 2 s of slack, three t in a row and no m anywhere: +5 s on the bottom corridor before the crumbles

62.note: the original cruel layout, four t in the exit column: the +5 s Revision A added comes back

72.note: the original layout was 27 s short on the straight route; two row-2 time losses go and +5 s sits on the exit column

59.note: ten sticky tiles, reverse and ice together is too much: no ice here

37.note: 37 and 38 are twins in Revision A; different tiles tell them apart
